izzyondroid:com.rosan.dhizuku.name: Dhizuku
izzyondroid:com.rosan.dhizuku.summary: A tool that can share Device Owner permissions to other applications.
izzyondroid:com.rosan.dhizuku.description:
This app can delegate functions from the device owner. That is, this app acts as an intermediary to call functions from the device owner.
 Normally, this authority can only be delegated to one app, but Dhizuku allows you to delegate the full authority of the device owner to other apps.
 It's easy to set up (ex: Shizuku, QR code). For more information, please see the tutorial .
 Usage example, it is ideal when you need to support two or more device owner permissions at the same time.
 Specifically, in Japan, you need to support both Aurora Store and Test DPC on a device with some limited functionality.
 Even if the app developer does not support Dhizuku, you can force support for Dhizuku by using the Dhizuku-API-Xposed module.

fdroid:com.exifthumbnailadder.app.name: Exif Thumbnail Adder
fdroid:com.exifthumbnailadder.app.summary: Add thumbnail in the EXIF tag of JPEG picture not having one (batch processing)
fdroid:com.exifthumbnailadder.app.description:
This application for android devices searches for pictures (JPEG) on your device and adds a thumbnail if they don't have one yet. Thumbnails are added to the EXIF metadata structure.
It is designed to work from android Oreo (android 8, SDK 26).
Please report issues here: https://github.com/tenzap/exif-thumbnail-adder/issues 
For more information, some known facts and how you may contribute, refer to the [project homepage][1].
 Rationale 
On some smartphones, when wanting to import pictures to Windows (or any device/operating system supporting MTP or PTP protocols), I noticed the pictures may not display a thumbnail in the import wizard (whether through the Photos app, or through the Windows Explorer import feature).
There are two possible reasons for that behaviour. First, the thumbnail is not present in the picture, usually because the app that created the picture didn't add a thumbnail. Second, there is a thumbnail but it is ignored because some EXIF tags are missing.
 Features 
- Add thumbnail to pictures (JPEG) that don't yet have one
- Lanczos algorithm to downsample picture thanks to [FFmpeg's swscale library][2] for best results.
- Select one or more folders to scan from any storage (internal, SDCard...). For example DCIM, Pictures...
- Exclude one subdirectory from selected directories
- Preserve timestamps of the pictures
- Processing log
- Synchronize deleted files in the source directory to the backup and working directory (so that you don't keep in the backup folder pictures you don't have anymore in the source folder)
- Conservative default options (backup pictures, skip corrupt files)
- Install app on internal storage or external storage
- Default EXIF library: [Exiv2][3].
- Alternative libraries: Android-Exif-Extended, libexif, pixymeta-android. See known facts on project page to learn more on benefits and drawbacks of each library.
- Settings: 
 - Rotate the thumbnail
 - Replace existing thumbnail
 - Backup of original pictures (backup is never overwritten by the app once created if you choose to add the thumbnail to the input file in its initial location)
 - Skip pictures having malformed metadata (this can be disabled to process also files having corrupt tags)
 - Replace picture in place or write new picture to another directory
 Requested permissions 
- WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE , READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE , READ_MEDIA_IMAGES 
- MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE 
- ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION 
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS 
- get more details on the project homepage
 Installation 
- Prerequisites: minimum android Oreo (android 8, SDK 26). App was tested up to Android 11.
- Download it through F-Droid app [here][4]
- Download the APK from the [release page][5]
 License 
GPL-3.0 (see "COPYING" file on project homepage)
 URLs 
- [1]: https://github.com/tenzap/exif-thumbnail-adder 
- [2]: https://ffmpeg.org/libswscale.html 
- [3]: https://www.exiv2.org 
- [4]: https://f-droid.org/packages/com.exifthumbnailadder.app 
- [5]: https://github.com/tenzap/exif-thumbnail-adder/releases

fdroid:eu.darken.myperm.name: Permission Pilot
fdroid:eu.darken.myperm.description:
Permission Pilot is a new kind of app to help you review apps and their permissions.
With each Android update permissions are getting more complex.
Android showing permissions in various different locations, doesn't make it easier to review them:
* App Info page
* Special Access
* Permissions Manager
* and more...
 Permission Pilot lists all permissions in a single location, giving you a bird's eye view of app permissions.
Two perspectives are available: You can either view all permissions an app requests, or view all apps that request a permission.
 Apps tab 
All installed apps, including system apps and work profile apps.
Clicking on any app will list all permissions that the app has requested, including those that show up under Permissions Manager and Special Access, along with their status.
This will also include internet permissions, SharedUserID status!
 Permissions tab 
All permissions that exist on your device, including those that show up under Permissions Manager and Special Access.
Permissions are pre-grouped for easier navigation, e.g. Contacts, Microphone, Camera, etc.
Clicking on a permission shows all the apps that request access to that permission.
Apps and permissions can be searched using free-text, sorted and filtered by different criteria.
 Overview 
A summary dashboard showing app counts by category — privacy, security, install source, and more. Each category row navigates directly to a filtered app list.
 Permission Watcher 
Get notified when an app update adds new permissions or changes existing ones. Permission Watcher checks your apps after each update and creates a report if anything changed.
 Data Export 
Export app or permission data in Markdown, CSV, or JSON.
 Manifest Viewer 
Browse raw app manifests with searchable, categorized sections. See which apps can discover other installed apps.

fdroid:io.github.dorumrr.de1984.name: De1984
fdroid:io.github.dorumrr.de1984.summary: Privacy-focused Firewall and Package Manager for Android devices
fdroid:io.github.dorumrr.de1984.description:
De1984 is a Firewall and Package Manager for Android that works with or without root.
The name De1984 comes from George Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four. It stands for resisting surveillance and taking back control of your device and data.
 FIREWALL FEATURES 
- Four firewall methods: iptables (root, or Shizuku in root mode), ConnectivityManager (Shizuku, Android 13+), NetworkPolicyManager (Shizuku, chosen manually) and VPN (no root, works everywhere). Picked automatically for your device. iptables blocks at kernel level
- On ROMs without POLICY_REJECT_ALL, NetworkPolicyManager only blocks metered background data, not WiFi
- Block WiFi, Mobile Data and Roaming separately with iptables and VPN (Roaming is part of Mobile Data). ConnectivityManager and NetworkPolicyManager block an app on all networks or none
- Block LAN access, enforced only by iptables
- "Block All by Default" (allowlist) or "Allow All by Default" (blocklist). Switching resets every app's WiFi, Mobile, Roaming and LAN rules to the new default, with no confirmation. System-recommended apps keep theirs, and critical and VPN apps keep theirs only while "Allow Firewall Critical Packages" is on
- Captive portal settings (root or Shizuku). They stay changed after De1984 is uninstalled
- Screen-off blocking to save battery and data
- Rules follow network changes in real time
 PACKAGE MANAGEMENT (Shizuku or root) 
- Enable or disable system apps, force stop apps, uninstall system and user apps
- Filter by system/user and enabled/disabled, and search
 PRIVACY FIRST 
- No tracking, analytics or telemetry
- Local-only data storage
- No proprietary libraries, no Google Play Services
- 100% open source (MIT License), buildable from source
 REQUIREMENTS 
- Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher
 PERMISSIONS 
- ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE: apply rules per network
- BIND_VPN_SERVICE: the VPN firewall
- QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: list installed apps
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS (optional): new app installs
- RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED: start the firewall after a reboot, if it was on
- FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE: keep the firewall running
- REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS (optional): stop Android killing the firewall
- KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES: last fallback for force stop
- Shizuku API: talk to Shizuku or Sui
- INTERACT_ACROSS_USERS: read apps in other profiles. When one exists, De1984 grants it to itself through root or Shizuku, without asking
- WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS, CHANGE_COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE: only checked, to show status
- REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES, INSTALL_SHORTCUT, ACCESS_SUPERUSER: declared, not used
- Root or Shizuku (optional): the iptables, ConnectivityManager and NetworkPolicyManager firewalls, package management, boot protection and captive portal settings
 OPEN SOURCE 
Source code: https://github.com/dorumrr/de1984
Issues: https://github.com/dorumrr/de1984/issues
Late nights for brighter days.
Created by Doru Moraru

 Why do I need it? 
The app is designed for those who simply want to keep track of cash flow, especially cash, without additional features and complications, such as managing credit cards, bank accounts or advanced financial instruments. Do you just want to track how you spend your cash? This is the right app for you.
 How it works 
The interface is designed to be simple and intuitive. To add a new transaction, simply click on the "+" button and fill in the form with the amount and a few words of description. With a simple swipe of the transaction, you can modify or delete it. If you want to change the currency, in the settings you will find all the currencies used in the world.
 Other features 
- You can search transactions by name to filter them and view a partial balance.
- By enabling the option in the settings, you can manage multiple accounts, each with its own list of transactions.

firefox-addons:745973.name: ScrollAnywhere
firefox-addons:745973.summary:
Scroll page without touching scroll-bar! 
Press Middle (Right / Left) mouse button anywhere on the page to scroll just like with scrollbar.
Features also:
- "grab and drag" scrolling
- customizable scrollbars!
- the Momentum auto-scroll
firefox-addons:745973.description:
Scroll Anywhere enables you to drag scrollbar with your middle (or right / left) mouse button without actually touching a scrollbar. Just hold the middle mouse button and move up-down or left-right. You can also change the behavior to simple "grab and drag" style.
Available also for your Thunderbird 78 email client !
 Short preview video here (0:12) 
 Warning: very addictive! :) 
 Features: 
 Momentum allows you to throw page to scroll it faster (just like on your phone)
 Middle / Right / Left mouse buttons are supported, see the Options page
 Customize scrollbars - make them thinner, change color or hide 
 Auto-disable on specified domains / sub-domains
 Grab and drag scroll like on your phone
 Multiplier to speed-up or slow down
 On key down enable / disable
 Custom scrolling cursor 
 Contribution: 
 I've spend more than 1,000 hours developing this add-on.
 Please consider supporting my work by:
 Buy me a coffee 
 PayPal donation 
 Become my Liberapay supporter! 
 Patreon 
 Thank you! :) 
 Your donation will help me keep this add-on working in future versions of Firefox!
 Social media: Facebook / Twitter 
 Known issues: 
 does not work HERE on https://addons.mozilla.org/ (blocked by Firefox) 
 does not work on browser specific pages like "about:addons" (blocked by Firefox)
 does not work in "PDF view" - broken by Firefox 60 
 does not work in "reader view" (blocked by Firefox), vote for bug 
 does not work on other extensions pages like options page of some addon (blocked by Firefox)
 may not work in nested IFRAME html elements (somehow Firefox won't inject it there)
 Be aware: 
 left mouse button support is experimental feature - please report any issues to my support e-mail.
 Linux users may want to enable "Don't block default button action" option in Options/Advanced - to enable 'Paste' with middle button again.
 in some Linux versions you may need to disable "middlemouse.contentLoadURL" in "about:config" to avoid navigating to URL from clipboard when pressing middle mouse button
 Recently added features: 
 The list of changes in last versions is available here

firefox-addons:2897428.name: Hamdast - RTL and Persian Font for AI Tools
firefox-addons:2897428.summary: افزونه همدست، راستچین و فارسیساز فونت برای ChatGPT، Gemini، Copilot، Claude و دیگر ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی. فارسیسازی فونتها بهسادگی.
firefox-addons:2897428.description:
افزونه همدست، راستچین و فارسیساز فونت برای ChatGPT، Gemini، Copilot، Claude و دیگر ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی. فارسیسازی فونتها بهسادگی
نسخه جدید افزونه راستچین فارسی هوش مصنوعی چت جی پی تی، منتشر شد!
تاریخ آپدیت: تیر ۱۴۰۵
- امکان انتخاب فونت هم اضافه شد.
- امکان تعیین راستچین هوشمند یا ساده اضافه شد.
همدست افزونهای سبک برای مرورگر Chrome است که نمایش متن فارسی و عربی را در ابزارهای منتخب هوش مصنوعی خواناتر و منظمتر میکند. ✨
اگر هنگام کار با ابزارهایی مثل ChatGPT، Gemini، Claude، Copilot یا Perplexity با متنهای چپچین، فونت نامناسب، جهت اشتباه نوشتهها یا ظاهر نامرتب متن فارسی روبهرو میشوید، همدست کمک میکند تجربه خواندن و نوشتن شما بهتر شود.
همدست محتوای پیامها، پرامپتها یا پاسخها را تغییر نمیدهد. این افزونه فقط ظاهر متن را در مرورگر شما بهبود میدهد تا متن فارسی و عربی راحتتر خوانده شود.
قابلیتها 🚀
✅ راستچینسازی متنهای فارسی و عربی
✅ بهبود خوانایی با فونت مناسب فارسی
✅ نمایش منظمتر متنهای ترکیبی فارسی، عربی و انگلیسی
✅ تنظیم جداگانه برای هر سایت پشتیبانیشده
✅ حالت سبک برای راستچینسازی بدون تغییر فونت
✅ امکان نمایش اعداد فارسی
✅ رابط ساده و سریع برای تغییر تنظیمات
چرا همدست؟ 💡
نمایش متن فارسی در بعضی ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی همیشه یکدست نیست. گاهی جهت متن درست نمایش داده نمیشود، فونت خوانایی کافی ندارد یا متنهای ترکیبی فارسی و انگلیسی ظاهر شلوغی پیدا میکنند.
همدست این مشکل را در سطح نمایش متن کاهش میدهد و کمک میکند مکالمهها، پرامپتها و پاسخهای فارسی را راحتتر بخوانید.
حریم خصوصی 🔒
همدست برای بهبود ظاهر متن در مرورگر طراحی شده است.
این افزونه محتوای چتها را برای پردازش به سرور خارجی ارسال نمیکند و پیامها، پاسخها، پرامپتها یا اطلاعات شخصی شما را برای تبلیغات، فروش داده یا اهداف نامرتبط ذخیره و منتقل نمیکند.
روش استفاده ⚙
 افزونه Hamdast را نصب کنید.
 وارد یکی از ابزارهای پشتیبانیشده شوید.
 همدست بهصورت خودکار نمایش متن فارسی و عربی را بهبود میدهد.
 برای تغییر تنظیمات هر سایت، روی آیکون افزونه کلیک کنید.
همدست برای تجربهای خواناتر و منظمتر هنگام کار با متن فارسی در ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی ساخته شده است. 🌱
Full Description - English
Hamdast is a lightweight Chrome extension that improves the display of Persian and Arabic text in selected AI tools. ✨
If Persian text appears left-aligned, hard to read, visually messy, or incorrectly mixed with English in tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, or Perplexity, Hamdast helps make the reading and writing experience cleaner.
Hamdast does not change the content of your messages, prompts, or responses. It only improves how text appears in your browser, so Persian and Arabic content becomes easier to read.
Features 🚀
✅ Right-to-left display support for Persian and Arabic text
✅ Improved readability with a Persian-friendly font
✅ Cleaner display for mixed Persian, Arabic, and English text
✅ Per-site settings for supported websites
✅ Lightweight mode for RTL-only display
✅ Optional Persian number display
✅ Simple controls for quick adjustments
Why use Hamdast? 💡
Persian text does not always appear correctly in AI interfaces. Text direction may break, fonts may be difficult to read, and mixed-language prompts can become visually confusing.
Hamdast helps reduce these display issues and makes Persian conversations, prompts, and responses easier to follow.
Privacy 🔒
Hamdast is designed to improve text appearance inside your browser.
The extension does not send your chat content to an external server for processing. It does not sell, store, or transfer your prompts, responses, or personal information for advertising or unrelated purposes.
How to use ⚙
Install the Hamdast Chrome extension.
Open one of the supported tools.
Hamdast automatically improves Persian and Arabic text display when needed.
Click the extension icon to adjust settings for each website.
Hamdast is built for a cleaner and more readable Persian text experience in AI tools. 🌱

firefox-addons:924854.name: Tab Save & Restore
firefox-addons:924854.summary: Saves the links of all open tabs and allows for one by one or all together restoration.
firefox-addons:924854.description:
This extension allows you to save the open tabs from your window and then restore them at a later time. You can restore them individually or all at once.
The motivation behind this extension is to allow for easy tab management without the hassle of being signed in to your browser. Oftentimes, I've wanted to save my open tabs before shutting down my computer, but I prefer not to attach an account to my browser. Before, I would waste time copying and pasting each tab's url to a text file so I could remember what I was doing. Now, by using this extension, it is simply a matter of clicking a few buttons to re-open all of your tabs.
For usage help, see the README on Github . Please submit any issues on Github as well.

bluejetty:00027402:ios.description:
Your favorite photo deserves more than a gallery scroll. Paint By Number Creator transforms it into a classic numbered painting you can enjoy yourself, share with family, or print as a handmade gift.
Open a picture, choose how detailed you want the palette, and watch regions and numbers appear. Prefer speed? Use Rough. Want finer shapes? Switch to Precise. Then paint digitally—fill everything at once or one area at a time—or export a crisp PDF with a color key for real paints and paper.
Why people love it
• Bring memories, pets, and portraits to life as numbered art
• Dial in 2–64 colors and A4, A3, or A2 paper for the look you want
• Rough for a quick result, Precise when every contour counts
• Flip between original, filled colors, and numbered outlines
• Playful fill modes: complete the whole picture or tap area by area
• Match paints with RAL, RGB, HEX, or Pantone FHI labels
• Export PDF with color key, print, or save JPEG views
• Keep projects in your library and pick up anytime
From rainy-day coloring to classroom crafts and thoughtful keepsakes, Paint By Number Creator makes creating feel easy—and finishing feel wonderful.

bluejetty:00039597:ios.description:
Heal at the root. Overcome daily stress, manage anxiety, and reconnect with your inner power.
Goddess is the ultimate science-backed holistic wellness app designed exclusively for women. The app goes beyond traditional mental health tools by addressing the root causes of daily struggles. By nurturing physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual well-being all at once, Goddess provides the fundamental solutions needed to truly heal, grow, and thrive.
Rooted in Jungian psychology and the scientifically proven benefits of mindfulness, Goddess offers a safe space for complete personal transformation.
DISCOVER YOUR GODDESS ARCHETYPE
Go beyond generic advice. Goddess offers a unique personality analysis based on Carl Jung’s psychological archetypes. Once a persona is discovered, the app customizes the entire experience—delivering daily affirmations and self-care rituals tailored exactly to your unique traits to help resolve inner blocks at their core.
ALL-IN-ONE WOMEN'S HEALTH & FEMININE ENERGY
Embrace divine feminine energy. Goddess guides you through your unique physiological and emotional journey with expert resources on cycle syncing, menstrual health, and hormonal balance. The platform fosters genuine self-love and raises feminine vibration from the inside out.
500+ HOLISTIC WELLNESS PRACTICES EXCLUSIVELY FOR WOMEN
Explore a deeply curated library built specifically for the female body, mind, and soul. Rather than just treating symptoms, Goddess targets root causes with practices grounded in neurological and behavioral science:
Guided Meditation & Mindfulness: Clinically proven techniques to reduce anxiety, process heavy emotions, and promote neuroplasticity.
Breathwork: Evidence-based breathing exercises to regulate the nervous system, lower cortisol levels, and manage stress.
Yoga & Somatic Practices: Mind-body routines designed for physical healing, nervous system resets, and emotional release.
Subconscious Reprogramming: Affirmations and sound therapies scientifically crafted to build true resilience and spiritual alignment.
DAILY RITUALS FOR SOULFUL LIVING
Take control of the day. Wake up with intention through empowering morning routines, and end the night with deep sleep meditations. Goddess delivers personalized daily feminine tips that prioritize holistic health and sustain motivation.
Meet the ultimate personalized spiritual well-being and holistic care coach today. Embark on this transformative path and awaken the Goddess within.
Any questions or suggestions? Contact: info@thegoddesswellbeing.com
Subscription & Terms
Goddess App offers auto-renewing subscription options:
To unlock all content, get The Goddess App Premium. There are three subscription plans: 1 month/$12.99, 12 months/$59.99 with a discount (50% off) subscription.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. 
The cost of renewal is equal to the value that “Apple’s App Store Matrix” determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD. 
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. 
Privacy Policy: https://goddesswomenapp.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://goddesswomenapp.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00026578:ios.description:
Zing is the ultimate AI Coach, revolutionizing fitness with AI-powered, personalized workouts designed by top health and fitness experts. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced athlete, Zing AI Coach adapts to your needs, offering real-time insights and support for a transformative fitness journey.
Advanced AI Coach
The AI Coach engages proactively, suggesting goals, scheduling workouts, and providing real-time form monitoring and feedback. It checks in daily about your energy levels, mood, and sleep, adjusting your workout plan in real-time to ensure continuous improvement.
Zing Vision
Our advanced Zing Vision technology uses your smartphone's camera to track movements in real-time, providing detailed insights to improve your technique.
AI Body Scan
Zing's AI Body Scan analyzes your body composition using your smartphone's camera. Receive insights into body fat, lean mass, and more, integrated into your fitness plan for a hyper-personalized experience. Photos are promptly deleted for privacy.
Hyper-Personalized Plans
Zing creates customized workout plans based on your unique body data, fitness background, and lifestyle. It dynamically adjusts workout intensity and complexity based on your progress, goals, and activity levels. The Strength Score helps you track and enhance your strength training, setting clear goals through increased workout intensity and repetitions.
Dynamic AI Workout Progression
Zing's AI adjusts your workout intensity and complexity continuously. Centralize all your activity data in Zing for detailed fitness insights. Seamlessly integrate with Apple Watch and Apple Health. Track your daily activity, earn milestones, and share achievements with friends for added encouragement.
World-Class Training
Zing Coach generates intuitive workouts from almost 500 exercises, adapting to your preferences and goals. It tracks muscle fatigue levels, ensuring safe and effective training sessions.
Diverse Workout Types
Zing offers various workout types including strength, HIIT, stretching, and recovery, with Pilates and yoga coming soon. Each type is designed to enhance different aspects of fitness, from muscle development and fat burn to flexibility and mind-body connection.
Fitness and Flexibility Tests
Take the Fitness Test to assess your current fitness level and the Flexibility Test to measure your mobility. Get personalized insights for your plan based on your results, and improve them with targeted exercises.
Community and Support

bluejetty:00033744:ios.description:
If you wish to relax after a long day at work or a long commute, playing with bouncy balls is the most relaxing thing you can do! It’s proven that it helps with your well-being, it reduces your stress level and it calms you down. It’s almost like a therapeutic, ASMR experience but accessible directly on your mobile and completely free of charge. Are you ready to experience a brand new relaxing gaming experience with a Ball Sort Puzzle game?
How to play:
- Tap on a bottle to pour its balls into another one, but remember, you can only pour some balls of the same color, and each bottle should contain only one color of ball.
- A bottle can only contain a certain amount of balls. When it’s full you cannot pour more balls into it.
- No timer, no stress, take your time. 
Game Benefits:
- Exercise your brain and stimulate your cognitive abilities with this challenging and addictive free puzzle game.
- Immerse yourself into beautiful graphics and a world full of colors 
- Unwind after a long day by relieving stress & relax with an intuitive rewarding puzzle game
- Experience a sense of satisfaction and accomplishment as you successfully sort each level and witness the harmony of colors.
So why wait? Download our Ball Sort : Puzzle game today and start playing! Whether you're looking to pass the time on your morning commute, unwind after a long day at work, or simply enjoy some relaxing gameplay, our game has everything you need to have a great time at home or on the go!.

bluejetty:00035275:ios.summary:
Embark on a New Fishing Game Adventure!
Spin the wheel of fortune to get coins and unlock magical sea creatures! Win rewards, catch fish, raid, loot treasure, and attack your friends while you restore and build your island in this exciting
bluejetty:00035275:ios.description:
Embark on a New Fishing Game Adventure!
Spin the wheel of fortune to get coins and unlock magical sea creatures! Win rewards, catch fish, raid, loot treasure, and attack your friends while you restore and build your island in this exciting fishing game. Enjoy this arcade fishing game with the Captain and his Pingo crew.
Looking for multiplayer fun? In Fish of Fortune, you can play solo or with friends, raiding and attacking their islands as you compete for fishing game glory and become the ultimate fishing master. Take a classic fishing game, give it a coin game twist, and add fun multiplayer mechanics. Raid your friends and gather energy to build your dream island!
Not Your Average Fishing Game
Fish of Fortune is a unique fishing game mixed with a thrilling island adventure. Raid friends, loot treasure, collect coins, and spin the wheel to unlock special rewards in this one-of-a-kind fishing experience.
Spin the Wheel of Fortune to Earn Loot!
Spin the wheel to reveal your fortune! Will you land on attack time, loot, shields, raid, puzzle, or coins? The possibilities are endless! Earn coins to upgrade and build your island and advance through fish levels in this thrilling fishing game. Earn shields to protect your island from other players trying to attack. Become the fishing coin master with the strongest island and the most loot in this epic adventure!
Earn Free Coins in Your Fishing Game!
Collect coins by spinning the wheel and use them to restore, decorate, and build islands. If you’re feeling lazy—like a fish out of water—you can use the autospin mode to collect coins while you sit back and relax in your fishing world. Attack and raid islands to steal loot and become the wealthiest fisherman in the game!
Let the Fishing Game Raid Games Commence!
Spinning the wheel isn’t the only way to win! Attack friends, raid them, and loot their islands to steal treasures and coins in this competitive fishing game. Become the coin champion of this exciting multiplayer adventure!
Play with Friends in This Epic Fishing Game!
Join the best fishing Captain, cute Pingos, and big fish in this fun coin game! Spin the wheel to earn coins, raid your friends’ islands, and build your own to be the strongest of all. Join our growing Fortune Fishers community on Facebook to play together, meet new friends, and earn big rewards in this cool fishing game!
Collect All the Fish Cards in This Fishing Game!
It’s not just about loot—it’s also about collecting treasures! Spin the wheel to gather and upgrade dozens of fish cards featuring characters from Fish of Fortune in this incredible fishing game.
Follow Fish of Fortune on Facebook for exclusive offers and bonuses in this fantastic fishing game!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FishOfFortune
Something fishy in the air? Having problems?
Please contact us in the game by clicking on the menu > Settings > Support or email us at support@whalo.com

bluejetty:00041284:ios.description:
With the Ding app, you can top-up any number, anywhere, easily. As the world’s leading mobile recharge service, we’ll deliver your top in 3 seconds. We love keeping you and your loved ones connected. We’ve also got some of your favourite gift cards here, for you to choose. Whether it’s for yourself, or you want to gift that special someone, with the gift of choice. We’ve got it all for you, right here.
It's the little things that really matter. Whether it's a quick ""Hello"", or a video call to wish them a Happy Birthday, every moment counts. Since 2006, we've been helping people send top-ups safely and securely and we've sent over 500 million top-ups in more than 150 countries. 
Whether you call it top-up, recharge, refill, airtime, load, credit, or something else, you can send it on the Ding app. Our app is available in 7 supported languages. You can download and use the Ding recharge app in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, German, or Russian.
Recharge 150+ countries
Add credit to your own phone or send it to your friend's and family's prepaid phones around the world. You can send airtime recharge to countries including Cuba, Jamaica, Philippines, Haiti, India, Mexico, Afghanistan, Ghana, Saudi Arabia, Dominican Republic, USA, Nepal and more.
The #1 international mobile top-up app
- The fastest way to send top-up: delivered in 3 seconds
- 24/7 multilingual customer support
- 100% secure online transactions processed by our dedicated fraud team
- Exclusive Ding discounts and promotions
- Over 1 million downloads
How to send top-up
 Download the Ding app and follow three easy steps to recharge your own phone or send mobile phone credit to a loved one anywhere in the world
1. Choose an amount of top-up to send 
2. Enter the number you want to recharge
3. Add your details & confirm
We'll do the rest; it really is that simple. In 3 seconds, the top-up will be delivered
Get the following and more with the Ding app:
Value for money
Choose from our range of data plans and bundles available from over 850 operators, to find what suits you best. You’ll also access exclusive in-app promotions and discounts. 
Already have an account?
If you already have a Ding account, login with your existing account and all your details and transaction history will follow you over. Easily send top-up, set auto top-up, or request top-up in app. If you haven't got your Ding account set up yet, don't worry it's just as simple.
Payment Methods
We accept all major payment methods, such as Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and more. Your details are protected with Trustwave 128-bit SSL encryption and monitored by our internal fraud team.
Auto top-up
To avoid you or a loved one running out of credit, our auto top-up feature helps you top-up right when you need to. You can choose to schedule auto top-up every 7, 14, 28, or 30 days. any discounts available, are automatically applied to auto top-ups. 
More than 600 mobile networks
We work with mobile carriers around the world to deliver your international mobile recharge in seconds. Choose from networks such as: Cubacel, Digicel, Nauta, Claro, Flow/Lime, Smart, Globe, Lycamobile, MTN, Movistar, Ooredoo, Orange, Airtel, Tigo, Virgin Mobile, Vodafone, Zain, AT&T, Telcel and many more.
So why wait any longer? Get the Ding app now for free and send a little joy so they know you're thinking of them."

bluejetty:00031144:android.summary: Unleash a new era of note-taking — crafted for Android tablets and stylus users. Whether you’re a student, educator, designer, or professional, this app blends the freedom of handwriting with powerful tools for organizing, annotating, and s
bluejetty:00031144:android.description:
Unleash a new era of note-taking — crafted for Android tablets and stylus users. Whether you’re a student, educator, designer, or professional, this app blends the freedom of handwriting with powerful tools for organizing, annotating, and syncing your ideas.
🖊️ Natural and Precise Handwriting
Experience ultra-low latency handwriting with pressure-sensitive brushes that respond just like pen on paper. Perfect for sketching, note-taking, or creating mind maps. Thousands of users call it one of the best handwriting experiences on Android.
🧠 Organize Your Thoughts, Your Way
Custom Canvas Options: Choose classic paper sizes or expand ideas freely on an infinite canvas — great for brainstorming and visual thinking.
Interactive Linking: Add clickable links between pages to build study guides, planners, or a personal knowledge base.
Notebook System: Create, sort, and search notebooks for fast access to all your materials.
📄 Import & Annotate Documents
Import and mark up documents in common formats — such as PDFs, images, Word or PowerPoint files. Highlight key points, add comments, draw diagrams, and even merge or split files for custom workflows.
🎨 Layer Support & Creative Tools
Use layers to separate handwriting, shapes, and highlights. Redesign without erasing. Create cleaner, more flexible content with ruler-guided pens and shape tools — ideal for diagrams, architecture, and study illustrations.
🔊 Audio Recording + Note Sync
Record meetings or lectures while taking notes
Tap handwriting to jump to specific moments in the recording
Playback tools let you adjust speed, skip silence, or loop key sections for study and review
🤖 AI-Powered Features (available in select regions)
Summarize Notes: Let AI extract the main ideas from your writing
Auto Outlines: Turn notes into structured outlines instantly
OCR + Translation: Convert handwriting or images into editable text, with built-in language translation
🎨 A Workspace That’s Yours
Personalize your workspace with custom paper templates, fonts, colors, grids, and stickers. Designed for those who value flexibility and expression.
📐 Precision Graphics Tools
Draw diagrams and illustrations with ruler-guided pens and shape tools — ideal for students, architects, or designers.
☁️ Cloud Sync
Sync your notes across devices using Google Drive or OneDrive. Your notebooks are always backed up and accessible — anytime, anywhere.
🚀 Don’t just take notes. Create, explore, and think freely with powerful tools designed for your Android tablet and stylus.
Download Notein today and bring your ideas to life.

bluejetty:00040465:ios.description:
In Bling’s newest Bitcoin-themed puzzle game, you’ll assist Bling’s Crumpty Dumpty as he sits on a wall of crypto blocks and awaits your help in coming up with an antidote for Leprechaunis Bitcoinitis! Bitcoin Blocks takes your classic fables and flips them on their head. 
This Bitcoin-themed adventure is a modern twist on the classic fable which answers the question ”What if Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall but didn’t have a great fall?” In our version Crumpty Dumpty sits on the wall but doesn’t fall. 
We begin as Leprechaunis Bitcoinitis is running rampant in the Kingdom of Crypto. The highly contagious disorder is infecting blockchain, and it is your prerogative to save the cryptoverse! As the protagonist our Bitcoin-shaped hero Crumpty, sits on the wall and guards the Kingdom of Crypto from having a great blockchain fall. 
Using his magical Bitcoin Blocks, he is able to keep Leprechaunis Bitcoinitis out of Crypto Kingdom. However, his blocks only carry a certain amount of BTC energy and in order to keep the forcefield strong, you must combine like-colored magical blocks in order to create a stronger Bitronus. 
In this post-apocalyptic crypto-themed combination sorting game, you’ll combine multi-colored bitcoin blocks creating powerful combinations to help clear up the blockchain. Crumpty Dumpty will help guide you through endless amounts of levels where using your color-matching skills you’ll create chain-clearing combination of Bitcoin Blocks. 
Help Crumpty Dumpty clear the blockchain, secure the bag, and earn Bling Points! 
Features: 
Hundreds of Levels 
Hilarious Puzzles 
Fables and Fairytales 
Magical Bitcoin Blocks 
Bitcoin Themed

Start your career as a kart racer and work your up to become the F1 Champion!

Gain experience to upgrade your character making you a better driver.

Prove it…

bluejetty:00037939:ios.description:
NFC Credit Card Reader - Mobile Wallet:
Easily scan and view public data from NFC-enabled EMV credit & debit cards. Explore card details from various banks around the world – all from your iPhone! 
Features:
Quick Scanning, Unlimited Access: 
Hold your card against the back of your iPhone to instantly read card number & expiry date. Quickly scan your ID, passport, and cards with your phone.
Safely Store all Documents:
Scan your documents and cards like loyalty cards, gift cards, travel cards, etc once for easy data access.
Global Compatibility: 
Supports Visa, MasterCard, AMEX, UnionPay, Discover, and more! 
Card Categories: 
Browse cards by type—Travel, Shopping, Rewards, Fuel, and more.
Save Your Faves: Bookmark cards for easy reference later. 
Privacy First: All data stays on your device — no online syncing. 
Supported Cards:
Visa, MasterCard, American Express, UnionPay, JCB, PCB, Discover, & more!
Your Privacy, Our Priority:
We never store or share your data. All scans and saved cards stay on your device or iCloud account – 100% encrypted.
Perfect For:
1. Business professionals
2. NFC hobbyists & tech-savvy users
3. Travelers needing secure access
4. Anyone who wants to simplify their digital life
Important Notes:
This is not a payment app — only for viewing and storing card info like eWallet.
No login is required — your data stays private.
Works with NFC-enabled devices only.
How It Works:
Hold your NFC cards against your iPhone.
View, store, and share cards details like number, expiry date, and more with Digital Wallet! 
Disclaimer: This app NFC Credit Card Reader - Mobile Wallet does not issue or apply for cards. It's for informational purposes only. 
Download NFC Reader & Mobile Wallet now and unlock the full power of NFC on your iPhone! If you love the app, rate us and share your feedback!

bluejetty:00032347:ios.description:
Discover "Spirit Voice", your personal gateway to the mystical realm.
This innovative app transcends the ordinary, offering users an unparalleled opportunity to engage 
in meaningful conversations with their guardian angels, spirits, and even ghosts. Whether you're seeking 
insights into love, health, wealth, or any other life question, "Spirit Voice" bridges the gap between our world 
and the beyond, delivering messages directly to you in clear, audible responses.
Key Features:
Dive into the mysteries of your life with the freedom to ask many questions. Whether it's guidance on personal 
matters or curiosity about the unseen, "Spirit Voice" is here to provide answers from a higher plane.
Audible Spiritual Responses: Experience the extraordinary as you listen to direct responses from the spiritual entities.
 "Spirit Voice" captures the essence of their messages, allowing you to hear wisdom that is meant specifically for you.
Direct Guardian Angel Communications: Connect with your personal guardian angel for guidance and protection. 
Our app facilitates a special connection, making it possible to receive personalized advice and support.
Engage with Spirits and Ghosts: Explore beyond the veil by initiating conversations with spirits and ghosts.
 Gain unique insights and understandings from those who reside in the spiritual realm, enriching your perspective on life and the afterlife.
Explore Various Life Themes: No matter the area of interest—love, health, financial prosperity, or personal 
growth—"Spirit Voice" offers guidance on all aspects of life, sourced directly from the spiritual world.
User-Friendly Design: Navigate through "Spirit Voice" with ease thanks to its intuitive interface, designed to 
make your spiritual journey as smooth as possible.
Privacy and Ethical Communication: We prioritize your privacy and the respectful treatment of spiritual entities.
 "Spirit Voice" ensures a secure and ethical environment for all interactions between users and the spiritual realm.
Why "Spirit Voice"?
"Spirit Voice" is not just an app; it's a revolutionary tool that opens up new dimensions of understanding and connection.
 It's designed for anyone drawn to the spiritual, from beginners to those deeply entrenched in spiritual practices. Our app 
goes beyond mere entertainment, offering a profound tool for personal growth and exploration.
Discover the voices waiting to guide you, the advice that can alter your life's trajectory, and the profound sense 
of connection that comes from communicating with the spiritual realm. "Spirit Voice" provides a unique, immersive experience,
 allowing you to hear the wisdom of the universe through the convenience of your iOS device.
Download "Spirit Voice" – where the unseen becomes heard, and the wisdom of the spiritual realm is just a question away.
Please note: 'Spirit Voice' has been thoughtfully developed for entertainment purposes. While it offers an engaging and immersive experience into the world of spiritual communication, it is important for users to approach the app with an understanding of its intended use. 'Spirit Voice' is designed to provide intriguing and enjoyable interactions with the spiritual realm, enriching your curiosity and offering a unique form of entertainment. We encourage users to engage with the app with an open mind and a light heart, enjoying the journey it offers into the mystical with the awareness of its creative purpose."

Key feature
bluejetty:00039390:ios.description:
Complete all your border procedures with the official Seychelles e-Border government app.
Simply provide the requested information and you can submit your Travel Authorization, Disembarkation and Embarkation Information Forms.
Key features:
- The fastest way to submit your application.
- Available for all people traveling to and from the Seychelles.
- Securely store your passport and contact information for yourself and anyone in your family to save time when you next apply.
- Store other documents, such as yellow fever vaccination certificates securely within the app
Please note that all data submitted via the app is used for the sole purpose of your Travel Authorization or Disembarkation and Embarkation Information Forms, unless you specifically opt-in to receive information from third parties.
To find out more, visit https://seychelles.govtas.com/ 
We look forward to seeing you in the Seychelles!

bluejetty:00021315:ios.description:
Pace helps runners plan races with clear targets, fast conversions, and practical split strategies.
Enter your target pace or speed and instantly convert between them, then see projected finish times across popular distances from 400m and the mile to 5K, 10K, Half Marathon, Marathon, 50K, 50 Mile, and 100 Mile.

bluejetty:00019537:ios.description:
DESIGN ANYTHING WITH CANVA
Canva is your all-in-one creative app for photos, videos and designs. Edit photos, remove backgrounds, make collages, cut videos and create logos, posters, resumes and presentations – all in one place. No design experience needed – just open the app and start creating.
CREATE ANYTHING YOU CAN IMAGINE WITH CANVA AI
Skip the blank box. With Canva AI, you can start with visual inspiration, shape it your way, and make something that feels uniquely yours. Canva AI helps you get started with a look you love, then it's over to you to make it unmistakably yours.
BRING YOUR IMAGES TO LIFE WITH THE AI PHOTO EDITOR
Edit photos like a pro in a few taps. Remove backgrounds in one tap, erase unwanted objects with Magic Eraser, swap or add anything with Magic Edit, and fine-tune brightness, contrast and saturation. Add text, filters and effects, or generate brand new images from a simple prompt.
MEET THE SIMPLEST, MOST POWERFUL CANVA VIDEO YET
Introducing the new Canva Video, as edited by you. Shaped by community feedback, we've built a cleaner timeline, added smarter shortcuts, and unlocked more creative control. Simple by default, with more power when it matters. Oh, and the duration button is back!
COLLAGE MAKER
Bring your favorite moments together with photo grids, layouts and video collages. Mix photos, clips and text, then customize every detail with your own style.
SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT
Design posts, reels, stories, thumbnails and memes for all your favorite platforms. Create a reel, a post and a story in the same project, then plan and schedule content so your feed stays fresh.
LOGO MAKER
Build a logo for your business, side hustle or team in minutes. Pick a template, tweak the fonts and colors, and keep your brand looking sharp everywhere.
POSTER MAKER & FLYER DESIGNS
Create eye-catching posters, flyers, invitations and banners with thousands of templates. Ideal for events, promotions, parties and school projects.
RESUME BUILDER
Craft a polished resume or CV that stands out. Browse professional templates, personalize your layout and download it as a PDF, ready to send.
WHITEBOARD & PRESENTATIONS
Brainstorm ideas on an infinite whiteboard, then turn them into slides. Build presentations, slideshows and visual docs that make your ideas easy to follow.
MILLIONS OF CREATIVE ASSETS
Explore a huge library of photos, videos, graphics, audio tracks and hundreds of fonts. Everything you need to make your designs look amazing is right at your fingertips.
TRANSLATE & RESIZE
Translate designs into over 100 languages and resize them for any format in a few taps. Reach more people without starting from scratch.
WORK TOGETHER
Share designs with friends, classmates or teammates, collaborate in real time and gather feedback fast. Your projects sync across your phone, tablet and computer, so you can pick up right where you left off.
CANVA FOR EDUCATION
Canva for Education gives eligible K-12 teachers and students a school-managed Canva experience built for the classroom, with built-in moderation and age-appropriate controls for safe, collaborative learning.
Download Canva today and start with a look you love.

Privacy Policy: https://www.canva.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Canva is your all-in-one creative app for photos, videos and designs. Edit photos, remove backgrounds, make collages, cut videos and create logos, posters, resumes and presentations – all in one place. No design experience needed – just open the app and start creating.

CREATE ANYTHING YOU CAN IMAGINE WITH CANVA AI
Skip the blank box. With Canva AI, you can start with visual inspiration, shape it your way, and make something that feels uniquely yours. Canva AI helps you get started with a look you love, then it's over to you to make it unmistakably yours.

BRING YOUR IMAGES TO LIFE WITH THE AI PHOTO EDITOR
Edit photos like a pro in a few taps. Remove backgrounds in one tap, erase unwanted objects with Magic Eraser, swap or add anything with Magic Edit, and fine-tune brightness, contrast and saturation. Add text, filters and effects, or generate brand new images from a simple prompt.

MEET THE SIMPLEST, MOST POWERFUL CANVA VIDEO YET
Introducing the new Canva Video, as edited by you. Shaped by community feedback, we've built a cleaner timeline, added smarter shortcuts, and unlocked more creative control. Simple by default, with more power when it matters. Oh, and the duration button is back!

COLLAGE MAKER
Bring your favorite moments together with photo grids, layouts and video collages. Mix photos, clips and text, then customize every detail with your own style.

SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT
Design posts, reels, stories, thumbnails and memes for all your favorite platforms. Create a reel, a post and a story in the same project, then plan and schedule content so your feed stays fresh.

LOGO MAKER
Build a logo for your business, side hustle or team in minutes. Pick a template, tweak the fonts and colors, and keep your brand looking sharp everywhere.

POSTER MAKER & FLYER DESIGNS
Create eye-catching posters, flyers, invitations and banners with thousands of templates. Ideal for events, promotions, parties and school projects.

RESUME BUILDER
Craft a polished resume or CV that stands out. Browse professional templates, personalize your layout and download it as a PDF, ready to send.

WHITEBOARD & PRESENTATIONS
Brainstorm ideas on an infinite whiteboard, then turn them into slides. Build presentations, slideshows and visual docs that make your ideas easy to follow.

MILLIONS OF CREATIVE ASSETS
Explore a huge library of photos, videos, graphics, audio tracks and hundreds of fonts. Everything you need to make your designs look amazing is right at your fingertips.

TRANSLATE & RESIZE
Translate designs into over 100 languages and resize them for any format in a few taps. Reach more people without starting from scratch.

WORK TOGETHER
Share designs with friends, classmates or teammates, collaborate in real time and gather feedback fast. Your projects sync across your phone, tablet and computer, so you can pick up right where you left off.

CANVA FOR EDUCATION
Canva for Education gives eligible K-12 teachers and students a school-managed Canva experience built for the classroom, with built-in moderation and age-appropriate controls for safe, collaborative learning.

Download Canva today and start with a look you love.

Privacy Policy: https://www.canva.com/policies/privacy-policy/

• Swap crypto: Trade across 170+ coins without leaving your wallet
• Pay bills: Settle airtime, data, electricity and cable TV with crypto
• Invoice in crypto: Send professional invoices, get paid, auto-convert to fiat
• Hold USD: Keep a USD wallet and move between crypto and cash freely

• The best rates, no hidden charges

• Real humans on support, 24/7

• Crypto wallets, cards and banking services facilitated through licensed partners

Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, USDC, BNB, Dogecoin, Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Tron, Avalanche, Solana, Toncoin, XRP — plus 170+ more for swapping.

bluejetty:00023036:ios.description:
Take command of your wireless service, anywhere at any time! The TracFone My Account App lets you manage most aspects of your wireless service right from your phone.
Here is how it works:
-Once downloaded, open the app and after agreeing with the End User License agreement, you will have the option to log in (if you already have a TracFone Account) or you can create an account by selecting Create an Account.
- Once logged in, you will be able to see your Service End Date, keep track of your Balance on your home screen, refill your Airtime by selecting Buy Airtime or Add Airtime if you have an Airtime PIN.
-Other features include Credit Card management, Adding or Deleting a Device from the Account, viewing your transaction history or you can use our retail locator. 
Airtime PINs are located on the back of the TracFone Service Card or on your register receipt. To read the PIN on the TracFone Service Card, simply locate the grey strip on the back of the card. Scratch off the gray strip in order to reveal the Service Card PIN.
Service Cards are sold at over 80,000 retail locations across the United States.
Not a TracFone customer? Switch now! Visit us at http://www.tracfone.com/ for more information
Tracfone from TracFone Wireless, a Verizon company.

This phone cleaning app helps you to smartly free up your iPhone and iCloud space and ins
bluejetty:00027366:ios.description:
If your iPhone is running out of space frequently, or you love to take a lot of photos and videos, then you definitely need this app – Phone Cleaner!
This phone cleaning app helps you to smartly free up your iPhone and iCloud space and instantly recover the storage capacity. It automatically detects all the useless files, including similar and duplicate photos/videos, large files on both your iPhone and iCloud, through a patent-winning algorithm. With this phone cleaner, you can always keep your iPhone clean and secure.
Use Phone Cleaner to
- Free up your iPhone and iCloud storage in seconds
- Clean up your useless photos/videos intelligently on your iPhone and iCloud
- Compress your large videos and photos, reduce the file size
- Batch merge duplicated contacts and remove incomplete contacts
- Backup your phone book to iCloud periodically
- Hide your secret contacts and photos in the password-protected secret space
- Private browser that leaves no trace
- Provide cleanup guidances to do further phone storage cleanup in other categories
- Save battery
[Features]
[Smart Scan]
Automatically computes duplicate and similar photos/videos, to allow you to delete them within a few taps.
[Photo and Video Cleanup]
Clean up your photo album for each category, intelligently figure out the useless photos and videos in your iPhone and iCloud.
- Clean up similar photos, duplicate photos
- Clean up large files
- Organize and clean up photos automatically by AI categories
- Clean up screenshots, screen recordings
- Clean up similar videos
- Cleaner for burst photos
- Clean up by Places
- Cleaner Internet downloaded photos and videos
[Manage Contacts]
- Back up and restore your point-in-time phone book with iCloud
- Intelligently group and merge duplicate contacts
- Delete/edit iPhone contacts in batch
- Detect incomplete contacts and delete/edit them directly
[Compressor]
- Compress your photos & videos without losing quality
- Reduce the size for your photos & videos
- Resize your photos & videos
[Game Mode]
Organize your photos and free up storage space in an efficient manner by Swipe gesture.
- Swipe left to delete
- Swipe right to keep
- Swipe up to mark the photo as favorite
[Secret Space with Password Protection]

bluejetty:00029041:ios.name: Phonics & ABC: Learn to Read
bluejetty:00029041:ios.summary:
The Phonics app for children is a powerful educational tool designed to teach children the 44 phonemes and letter sounds through fun and interactive read along books, learning activities, and flashcards. 
Developed by Smart Kidz Club with
bluejetty:00029041:ios.description:
The Phonics app for children is a powerful educational tool designed to teach children the 44 phonemes and letter sounds through fun and interactive read along books, learning activities, and flashcards. 
Developed by Smart Kidz Club with the "just right" reading condition without any animations and distractions, this app uses human voice narration and is designed to make learning phonics focused, easy, and enjoyable for young children.
The Phonics app will help children
• Build a solid letter sound knowledge
• Help with speech and language development
• Enhance their early literacy and reading skills
• Get a head start at school with higher reading readiness
The app introduces children to each of the 44 phonemes (letter sounds) and their corresponding graphemes, letters that make up that sound.
Each phoneme is taught through a list of that contains that sound and is supported by an image. There is a separate book and flashcard for the beginning, middle, and ending sounds of vowels, consonants, and digraphs.
Once children have learned the phonemes and letter sounds, they can move on to the practice activities. These learning activities are designed to help children practice their phonics skills such as matching sounds to pictures. 
The activities are interactive and provide immediate feedback, allowing children to learn from their mistakes and improve their phonics skills.
The app also includes a comprehensive set of flashcards that children can use to practice their phonics skills. 
The flashcards are organized by phoneme and include pictures and words that use the corresponding sound. Children can swipe through the flashcards at their own pace, listening to the sound and practicing saying the word. This feature is perfect for children who prefer to learn at their own pace and for parents who want to help their children practice phonics skills outside of the app.
The Phonics app for children is designed to be user-friendly and intuitive, with simple navigation and clear instructions. The app is suitable for children of all ages, from preschoolers to early elementary school students. It can be used both in the classroom and at home.
The Phonics app for children is an excellent tool for teaching children the 44 phonemes and letter sounds. Whether used in the classroom or at home, the Phonics app for children is an excellent tool for supporting children's literacy development.

bluejetty:00021621:ios.description:

bluejetty:00028829:ios.description:
TapTap Match is a matching game where you need to pair tiles with identical pics. The task is simple - find identical images and link them together with three lines max. Try to solve each puzzle before the time runs out! 
How to play
Tap one time to select a tile. Then find an alike tile to link it with. Try to imagine a future path between them. The puzzle allows to draw three lines maximum connected at a 90 degree angle. Can you link tiles like that? If yes, you're good to tap for the second time. By the way, the longer the path - more bonuses you'll get. Use your brain and logic!
Doesn't sound challenging enough? Well, try the bomb mode, where certain tiles are blocked and very explosive! Or check out the sliding mode, where each row slides aside as you crush a pair of blocks. 
Why we love TapTap Match:
- Colorful collections of tiles with sweets, fruits and other cute images on them!
- More than 1000 levels
- Challenging extra modes
- Various hints 
- Progress saving puzzle game
Such a simple and cool application to relax and train the brain! What else is needed?
Try to download and play now!

As the app opens, you receive a message from a stranger.

bluejetty:00039817:ios.summary:
With Rejsebillet you can buy tickets and commuter passes for bus, train, metro, and light rail in all of Denmark.
If you are travelling one time from A to B, you can buy a ticket by entering your point of departure and arrival and complete
bluejetty:00039817:ios.description:
With Rejsebillet you can buy tickets and commuter passes for bus, train, metro, and light rail in all of Denmark.
If you are travelling one time from A to B, you can buy a ticket by entering your point of departure and arrival and complete a purchase. The ticket is valid for one progressive journey on the route shown on the ticket. If you accept localization, your point of departure will be your current position by default.
You can also buy a zone ticket. It allows you to travel unlimited with bus, train, metro, and light rail in the selected zones within a certain time period.
If you buy a Commuter Pass you get unlimited access to journeys by bus, train, and light rail within a specific area and a certain time frame. You can choose to buy access to DSB 1’ as an addition to your Commuter Pass. On Zealand you can buy a Commute20.
If you travel in the capital area and want to travel by metro with your commuter product, you can buy a metro supplement as a part of your pass. If you chose not to buy metro supplement with your pass and want to travel by metro a given day, you can purchase a supplementary metro ticket to gain access to the metro from day to day.
It is also possible to buy a ticket for your bicycle if you are travelling with the metro. You can also buy a supplementary ticket for DSB 1’ if you want to travel first-class by train from day to day. Each product requires that you already have a ticket that covers your journey.
Rejsebillet is developed by Rejsekort and Rejseplan A/S. Rejsekort og Rejseplan A/S ensures the collaboration between Arriva Tog, DSB, Nordjyllands Trafikselskab, Trafikselskabet Movia, FynBus, Sydtrafik, Midttrafik, Bornholms Amts Trafikselskab, and Metroselskabet to help create a cohesive public transport system in Denmark.
To start using Rejsebillet you need to enter your phone number, which all your future purchases will be linked to. If you are buying a commuter product, you need to enter further information, including name, email, and date of birth.
Purchases in Rejsebillet is made by using MobilePay, Apple Pay, or your payment card. You can save your payment card details in Rejsebillet and access them via biometrics or a PIN code chosen by you, so you do not have to enter all card details every time you buy a ticket or renew a commuter product. The following cards are accepted for payment: Visa/Dankort, MasterCard, Visa, Visa Electron, and Maestro. The payment card details are stored with Billwerk+.
Remember always to purchase your ticket before starting your journey.

bluejetty:00034012:ios.description:
Be better prepared for any emergency with Smart911. By signing up, you can share lifesaving information about your household with 9-1-1 and receive targeted emergency alerts.
When you call 9-1-1, your Smart911 Safety Profile displays on the 9-1-1 screen. Getting Start
bluejetty:00037781:ios.description:
Stay connected and make remote work easier with 3CX. This app allows you to use your office extension from anywhere and not only for calls. Schedule conferences, chat with your colleagues and video call from your iOS device. 
Getting Started:
1. Install the app.
2. Open it, read and accept the license agreement and authorize the permissions the app needs (camera, microphone).
3. Open your web client or desktop app and click on the QR code in the top right corner. Details on how to access your web client are in your 3CX email sent by your administrator.
4. Open your camera on your iOS device and scan the QR code shown on your screen.
5. Your extension is configured and you’re now “Ready for calls”!
Important: This app is only for use with 3CX V20 and is not a standalone app. 
More information: https://www.3cx.com/user-manual/installation-iphone/

bluejetty:00031939:ios.description:
UNLOCK EVERY MOMENT OF YOUR MEMBERSHIP
Download the Life Time app and unlock everything your membership includes. Reserve studio classes, connect with a Dynamic Personal Trainer, order from the LifeCafe, book LifeSpa services, and track your workouts, all from your phone. Your membership, fully realized.
L•AI•C — YOUR PERSONAL CONCIERGE
Meet L•AI•C ("lay-see"), your AI-powered guide to the club, built on Life Time expertise. More than an assistant, L•AI•C is your coach, guide, and concierge, tailored to you.
• A concierge that gets you. Find classes, reserve courts, schedule appointments, and discover experiences personalized to your habits and your club. 
• Personalized plans, real results. Dynamic workouts built for your goals, schedule, and lifestyle. Whether you are training for a race, building strength, or improving sleep, L•AI•C keeps you moving forward. 
• Expert answers, instantly. Ask anything from "How do I recover faster?" to "What's a high-protein breakfast?" and get advice grounded in Life Time expertise. 
NAVIGATE THE CLUB 
• Check in to the club and manage your day from the app with hours, amenities, and reservations at your fingertips. 
• Find your perfect group fitness class, with 40-plus formats to choose from, including strength, cardio, yoga, barre, Pilates, and studio cycling. 
• Reserve sports and courts, kids activities, and recovery appointments in seconds.
•Order a meal or protein shake from the LifeCafe after a workout, or head to the Beach Club and order food and beverages poolside. 
TAKE TRAINING FURTHER 
• Get matched with a Dynamic Personal Trainer who can help you achieve your goals. Or experience the transformative effects of classical Pilates and Dynamic Stretch sessions. 
• Follow nutrition plans built by registered dietitians and nutrition coaches. 
• Get personalized workouts curated by L•AI•C based on your goals, preferences, and lifestyle. 
• Guided meditations, stretching, and breathwork help you recover intentionally. 
STAY ACCOUNTABLE TO YOUR PLAN 
• Follow a training program and track every detail of your workouts within the app. 
• Track steps, sleep, weight, and body composition in one place. 
• View your club visits and watch your progress build over time. 
FOR ATHLETIC EVENTS PARTICIPANTS
Training for a race takes more than a training plan. The app supports you from registration to the finish line. 
• Find and register for Life Time's premier athletic events nationwide, including marathons, cycling races, and triathlons.
• Follow expert-designed training and recovery programs built to boost endurance and speed up recovery. 
• Access your digital event pass and check in seamlessly on race day. 
FOR GUESTS OF MEMBERS
As a guest of a member, you will claim your guest pass right in the app and see what you've been invited to.
• Claim your digital guest pass and check in to the club with a simple scan. 
• Ask L•AI•C anything, from club hours to what to bring, and get answers built for your first visit. 
• Browse the full class schedule and see what's live in the studios, from studio cycling to strength training to yoga. 
• Discover club amenities, LifeSpa services, and the cafe menu, and see what a full membership includes. 
• Loved your visit? Find the nearest club and join the community in a few taps 
FOR CLUB MEMBERS 
ENHANCED FEATURES FOR OUR CLUB MEMBERS
• Check in to the club and sign up for events.
• Reserve classes, camps, and more.
• Order from the café, bistro, or book LifeSpa services.
• Manage your membership anytime. 
Manage your membership anytime, right in the app. Download today and start unlocking everything Life Time has to offer. 
Some features may require a Life Time membership. Consult a physician before starting any fitness program.
Privacy Policy: https://my.lifetime.life/policy/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: http://www.apple.com/legal/itunes/appstore/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00044537:ios.description:
Tape Measure App・Ruler & Level is a professional-grade digital measuring software for iOS. This high-precision application utilizes advanced AR technology and integrated smartphone sensors to replace bulky physical tools. Access a comprehensive suite of virtual instruments, featuring a smart digital ruler and a precision bubble level interface designed for maximum accuracy in any mobile environment.
Using advanced Augmented Reality (AR) and LiDAR technology, this app allows you to measure distances, heights, and areas with professional accuracy. Whether you are an architect, a contractor, a DIY enthusiast, or just need to measure a room for new furniture, our tool is designed for you.
KEY FEATURES:
◉ AR Tape Measure & Ruler
Measure linear sizes in cm, m, mm, inches, or feet. Simply point your camera and tap to measure length, width, and height of any object in the real world.
◉ Distance & Height Tool
Instantly measure the distance from your device’s camera to a specific point. Easily determine the height of walls, doors, or people.
◉ Area & Floor Plan
Need to calculate square footage? Select the corners of a room or surface to instantly get the area measurement. Perfect for flooring, painting, and construction estimates.
◉ Bubble Level Tool
Ensure your paintings hang straight and your shelves are perfectly aligned. Our precise digital level works on both vertical and horizontal surfaces.
◉ LiDAR Scanner Support
Utilize the power of the LiDAR sensor (on supported devices) for faster, more accurate scanning and room mapping.
◉ Save & Share
Save your measurements and floor plans directly in the app. Share them with clients or family members in a few taps.
WHY CHOOSE US?
- User-friendly interface: clean and intuitive.
- High precision: powered by Apple’s latest ARKit.
- All-in-one utility: Ruler, Tape Measure, Level, and Plan Maker.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
Subscribe to get unlimited access to all Pro features, including Area Tool, Floor Plan export, and Ad-free experience.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://measureapp.biz/Terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://measureapp.biz/Privacy-Policy.html

bluejetty:00013670:ios.summary: Start your reading adventure with immersive chat stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat! Whether you are a fan of terrifying horror tales, gripping thrillers, sweet romances, or funny comedies, there is something here for every
bluejetty:00013670:ios.description:
Start your reading adventure with immersive chat stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat! Whether you are a fan of terrifying horror tales, gripping thrillers, sweet romances, or funny comedies, there is something here for everyone.
Get ready to be pulled into stories that blur the lines between fiction and reality. Our app has a unique chat-based format that makes reading feel like a real conversation. You're not just observing the story; you're in it, living every plot twist and turn with the characters.
But that's not all! Unleash your creativity and write your own chat stories. With our easy-to-use tools, you can craft and edit your narratives, bringing your ideas to life. 
~ Genre Variety & Story Interactivity
Scary, funny, mystical, adventurous—we've got stories for every taste. Pick a story that matches your mood and start reading short chat messages that will keep you hooked from start to finish! Our stories include interactive elements such as photos and videos to make the experience even more engaging.
~ Reading Tracker & Favorites
Enjoy a smooth reading experience with our app. You can easily track how much is left in each chapter and the entire story. Like your favorite stories with a single tap and add others to your bookmarks for future reading. See a list of stories you've already finished and those you're eager to start next.
~ Story Creation & Editing
Have you ever wanted to write your own story? Our app gives you the tools to do that. Use your imagination to create the scariest, most mysterious chat story ever, filled with ghosts, vampires, zombies, and more! You can create complex characters, weave intricate plots, and build suspense with every message. Whether you're an experienced writer or just starting out, our app is the perfect place to unleash your creativity.
~ Chat Settings & Customization
Personalize your reading experience to match your preferences. Adjust the font size for optimal readability, select from various color schemes to suit your style, and customize the chat bubble shapes to give your stories a unique look.
What will you choose to read today?
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe and get right now:
1. Premium stories.
2. Story style customization.
3. Regular updates.
4. Content without ads.
Make your life easier with premium access: 
- Paid subscription is divided into 3 types: weekly, monthly and annual.
- The cost of a weekly paid subscription is $9.99. Monthly - $15.99. Annual - $49.99.
- The amount will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel a subscription or trial period at any time, but no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE it will be automatically renewed.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- After payment, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings.
- Any unused portion of the free period will be forfeited upon purchase of the subscription.
- Please read our privacy policy and EULA
https://appenvisions.com/privacy.html
https://appenvisions.com/eula.html

bluejetty:00042641:ios.description:
Gear up, pilot! In Air Commander: War Shooter, you’ll take control of a powerful military aircraft and provide critical aerial firepower to your comrades on the ground. 
This is not just another shooter game – it’s an immersive war experience that puts you in the cockpit of a heavily-armed gunship. Your mission? Defend your squad from relentless waves of enemies using an arsenal of devastating weapons. 
Dive into intense battles as you face diverse enemy units, from infantry and armored vehicles to helicopters and drones. Each wave brings new challenges that will test your reflexes and tactical thinking. Equip yourself with cutting-edge weapons like machine guns, missile launchers, and even powerful bombs to dominate the battlefield and turn the tide of war in your favor. 
The stunning graphics and immersive sound effects bring the chaos of war to life. Feel the roar of your engines as you unleash destruction from above and experience the adrenaline rush of aerial combat. With smooth controls and thrilling missions, Air Commander delivers an action-packed shooter experience like no other. 
Upgrade your gunship, unlock new weapons, and customize your loadout to adapt to different battle scenarios. Whether you’re a casual player or a seasoned shooter fan, this game offers endless action and strategic depth. 
Join the fight today in Air Commander: War Shooter and become the ultimate guardian of the skies. War is calling, soldier – are you ready to answer?

Break history and wreck the meta! Asia's beloved RPG released in English with a new tutorial & jacked up rewards to gently guide you into the ultra-violent wastelands!
【Free stuff! Great values! 】

The game has a unique Historical mode which combines the fun of a top-down RPG game with an advanced tactical battle system. Meanwhile, you may become legendary heroes like Zhao Yun and Lu Bu to re-experience the epic historical battles and create your own stories. There is always something to do no matter what level you are!
【Gathering together to fight for your Legion】
Once we become brothers and sisters, we will fight until the end of the world! Grow your legend with your friends. Fight against the most dangerous enemies and explore the mysterious Instances. Keep developing and growing to conquer the world.

Welcome to this wonderful casual puzzle matching game!
This is a super fun game! We need a detective, find and collect target items between different maps, you can get great relaxation and hone your mind. Just click to collect. A good choice to release stress and kill time!

● Easily train your brain!
● Collect gold coins by completing levels and win super value rewards!
● Easy to get started, suitable for all ages!

bluejetty:00034940:ios.description:

bluejetty:00029163:ios.name: Number Match - Ten Pair Puzzle
bluejetty:00029163:ios.summary: Number Match - Ten Pair Puzzle is a classic logic game with simple rules - match pairs of numbers to clear the board. This puzzle game is also known as Ten Pair, Digits, Numberama, Take Ten, or 10 Seeds. You might play this classic board ga
bluejetty:00029163:ios.description:
Number Match - Ten Pair Puzzle is a classic logic game with simple rules - match pairs of numbers to clear the board. This puzzle game is also known as Ten Pair, Digits, Numberama, Take Ten, or 10 Seeds. You might play this classic board game by using a sheet of paper before, but nowadays you can conveniently play it online on your mobile phone anytime and anywhere.
How to play
-The goal is to clear all the numbers on the board.
-A pair can be removed from the number grid if either the two digits are same (2 and 2, 6 and 6) or the sum of the two digits is 10 (1 and 9, 3 and 7).
-Tap on the two numbers one by one to cross out them on the board and get points.
-Pairs can be cleared in adjacent horizontal and vertical cells, as well as at the end of one line and the beginning of the next.
-If you run out of moves, you can add the remaining numbers to extra lines at the bottom.
-Boosters will help you to speed up the progress and get more chances to clear the board.
-You win once all the numbers are removed from the number puzzle blocks.
Features
-Delectable and enjoyable graphics
-Relaxing, addictive and challenging
-Classic logic gameplay with numbers
-No time limit
-Useful boosters: hints, bombs, swaps and undos
Number Match is an easy to learn logic puzzle game but may harder than you think when you play further. Take a break in your busy life and play Number Match - Ten Pair Puzzle whenever you feel tired, bored or want to relax. Train your logic and math skills while solving addictive math number puzzles!

bluejetty:00015482:ios.description:
MIO is an educational app for children aged 1 to 8, created by educators and speech therapists. It contributes to diversified child development in a fun, fascinating, and professional manner.
PLAYFUL EXERCISES
MIO skillfully transforms learning into a compelling game. Children learn their first words, complete speech exercises, and solve funny puzzles with great interest. All of it is thanks to animated tasks and a reward system that naturally encourages the child to progress. Overall, the app contains 100 interactive exercises to develop speech and motor skills, expand vocabulary, and improve coordination.
INTERACTIVE PUZZLES
MIO offers puzzles adapted to your child’s age and skills. They stir up interest in the tasks and make them more diverse. Jigsaw puzzles intentionally consist of parts with irregular forms: this way, they better develop the child’s motor skills, coordination and special thinking.
МІО app features:
- Seven categories of educational tasks: jigsaw puzzles, learning words and numbers, training exercises, etc.
- Over 200 speech exercises: training cheeks and tongue, forming the most complex sounds (R, SH, S).
- Great for kids aged 1 to 8.
- Personalized learning program for each child.
- Parental control.
- Approved by children and educators.
- Modern animations that are captivating both for a toddler and an 8-year-old.
- Gaming process adapted for kids.
Parents across the world choose the MIO app. Download it and enjoy how easily and efficiently your child develops. Most importantly, all of it is possible with your minimum participation.

• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
