bluejetty:00017548:ios.description:
Get the AF247 app for 24/7 access to cash anytime, anywhere. The Advance Financial app gives you an at-a-glance snapshot of your loan so you always know exactly how much available cash you have. Other features include making payments, knowing your balance and starting and finishing an application online for fast approvals and same-day funding.*
The AF247 app puts you in total control of your cash**
- Check your available credit & credit limit
- Access cash anytime, anywhere
- Make loan payments
- Know your balance, minimum payment & total payoff amount
- Start your application on your mobile device
- same-day funding*
Location Services
While the AF24/7 Mobile App is running, it uses real-time location services in order to trigger geolocation-specific notifications.
We’re here to answer your questions and help with your application. Contact us by phone at 888-462-0535 or by e-mail at m.customer@af247.com.
Advance Financial delivers fast cash when you need it
Advance Financial loans are different from same-day payday loans, title loans, and other cash advances. With our FLEX Loan open-ended line of credit, you apply just once, then withdraw as much or as little cash as you need (up to your credit limit). 
Repayment terms are different, too. Payday and title loans give you only weeks to repay your full balance, plus interest. You repay your Advance Financial FLEX Loan or Installment Loan with conveniently scheduled payments aligned with your payday. Plus, with a FLEX Loan open-ended line of credit, you only pay for the cash you need and only for the time you need it. And as you pay down your balance, you regain access to funds for future cash advances. There are never any penalties for repaying either loan early.
Founded in 1996, Advance Financial is a family-owned fintech company based in Nashville, Tennessee. The company operates over 100 stores throughout Tennessee and online loan services in more than 13 states including Alabama, California, Delaware, Idaho, Kansas, Mississippi, Missouri, North Dakota, South Carolina, Tennessee, Utah, and Wisconsin. Advance Financial provides fast lending decisions on line of credit loans, installment loans, and other financial services, 24/7/365. Tennessee store customers have access to cash loans, check cashing, free money orders, bill-pay services, ATM services, Western Union wire transfers, and NetSpend Prepaid cards.
Recent recognition includes being named a Top Work Place in 2022 by the Tennessean and named a Best Employer for New Grads and America’s Best Midsize Employers by Forbes in 2022. Advance Financial has an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau.
*Bank participation required
** Wi-Fi or mobile data is required for access. Deposit times for online loans vary by bank. Bank participation is required. Please see our website for terms and conditions. Please borrow responsibly.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
_________________
From the creators of The Sims™ comes a complete Sims experience on mobile! Grow SimTown to expand your Sim community and create an entire town with your own style, personalities and dreams! Complete goals to earn Simoleons and pick up rewards along the way. Keep your Sims happy and watch them thrive as you help them live a fun and fulfilled life!
 _________________
 SIM-ULATING POSSIBILITIES
 From head to toe – and floor to ceiling – customize every aspect of your Sims’ lives! Keep up to 34 Sims looking stylish, and design and build their dream homes complete with swimming pools, multiple floors and incredible decor. As you get more Sims and they start a family, expand your Sim Town with a pet store, car dealership, shopping mall, and even a private villa beach! Express yourself and tell your own Sims story by unleashing your inner architect and interior designer all at once. Visit your real friends’ Sim Towns, where you can form new relationships and compare your friends’ interior design skills against yours.
 STAY CONNECTED
 Life is better together. Start relationships, fall in love, get married, and have a family. Make lifelong friends and care for pets. Throw pool parties and grill outdoors or snuggle up by the fireplace for movie night. In the mood for some trouble? There’s plenty of drama to be had when Sims don’t get along. Act silly with teens, be rude to family members, or even say no to a marriage proposal! From babies to seniors, your perfect Sims story can happen at every stage of your life simulation. Love and friendships? Drama and breakups? The choice is always yours.
 ALL WORK & ALL PLAY
 A Sim’s gotta work! Start different dream careers, and even follow Sims’ days at the Police Station, Movie Studio, and Hospital. The more your Sims go to work, the more they learn skills and raise their salary, giving you rewards and setting them on a path to success. In their free time, choose different hobbies like cooking, fashion design, salsa dancing, and puppy training. The more involved they are, the happier they’ll be, from kids to teens to adults. The opportunities are limitless when you create a life your Sims love!

bluejetty:00027311:ios.description:
Get ready to take your songwriting skills to the next level with Suggester 2 - the ultimate app for creating powerful and emotive chord progressions! Whether you're a seasoned musician or a budding songwriter, this app will revolutionize the way you compose music, helping you to unlock new creative possibilities and reach new heights of productivity.
With its intuitive interface and cutting-edge features, Suggester 2 is the perfect tool for exploring the harmonic relationships between chords and discovering new musical ideas. Whether you're composing for piano, guitar or ukulele, this app will adapt to your needs, providing you with a wealth of powerful tools to help you create music that truly moves your listeners.
With Suggester 2, you can choose chords based on their harmonic function, using the powerful roman numeral notation to create progressions that are both dynamic and satisfying. This app will guide you every step of the way, suggesting chords that fit with your existing progressions and helping you to build your songs from the ground up.
But Suggester 2 isn't just about finding the right chords - it's also about creating tension and resolution, the heart of great music. With its ability to suggest chords that work together, this app is an essential tool for composers looking to create music that truly moves their listeners.
And if you're looking for inspiration, Suggester 2 has you covered there, too. With its library of classic chord progressions, you can draw on the rich history of music to create progressions that are both timeless and contemporary. Whether you're looking to recreate the sounds of your favorite songs or explore new musical styles, Suggester 2 has everything you need to create music that truly speaks to your soul.
And with its seamless integration with other apps and MIDI devices, Suggester 2 makes it easy to bring your music to life. Whether you're exporting your songs as audio, MIDI, or text, or using the app as an AudioUnit plugin (AUv3), you'll be able to create music that truly captures your vision.
Download Suggester 2 today and unlock the full potential of your songwriting skills! With its powerful features, intuitive interface, and endless creative possibilities, this app is sure to become your go-to tool for composing music.

Wherever you may be in your savings journey, Vestwell grows with you. Our platform is a versatile, one-stop solution for all of your financial needs, including retirement, education, disability and emergency savings solutions. Join more than one million savers who trust Vestwell to save for life’s milestones. 
Build Your Financial Future
Simplify your savings journey and easily track your progress toward your long-term and short-term financial goals—all on one intuitive platform.

Experience Modern Technology
Take advantage of our streamlined user experience, which makes navigating your savings portal a breeze. Sign up in 3 minutes or less, and set or adjust your savings with just a few clicks. 
Have Peace Of Mind
Our platform was designed with security in mind. We safeguard your data consistent with industry best practices. 
See how you can save with the Vestwell mobile app, designed to help you build your savings confidently.

bluejetty:00034904:ios.description:
Send messages to your future self!
Write a note. Pick a moment: a date, a time, or a place. HiFutureSelf delivers it exactly when you need it. Your grocery list as you walk into the store. A pep talk before the gym. A quiet "breathe" as you step out the door.
The simplest reminder app you'll ever use. And the most thoughtful.
*Celebrating 16 years on the App Store!*
WHAT YOU CAN SEND
• A note to yourself tomorrow, next month, or ten years from now.
• A voice memo recording for your future self.
• A photo, a face, a moment, a memory to land at the right time.
• A secret message to a friend. Surprise the people you love with a note that arrives exactly when they need it.
WHEN IT ARRIVES IS UP TO YOU
• Any future date and time, down to the minute.
• The moment you arrive at or leave a place.
• Hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or on the specific days you choose.
• Pause anytime with a swipe. Resume the same way.
BUILT TO STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY
• 5 home screen widgets so your upcoming messages are always in view.
• Light and dark mode, matched to your iOS theme automatically.
• A library of motivational messages for the days the words won't come.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases. No data collection. Your messages live on your device, with optional iCloud sync. Works fully offline.
Download HiFutureSelf. Free. Start writing to the version of you who'll need it most.

bluejetty:00029773:ios.description:
Get ready for the ultimate trucking experience with the highly anticipated Ultimate Truck Simulator Games! Europe truck driver simulator an immersive city game combines the excitement of truck driver games, truck racing games, and truck driving games into one action-packed adventure. Take on challenging missions, conquer extreme terrains, and become the master of the road in truck games world.
A Trio of Truck Games, Truck Parking Games, and Truck Driving Games If you're a truck enthusiast, this game is a dream come true. With three mentions of "truck games," "truck Parking games," and "truck driving games," the Ultimate euro Truck Simulator Game offers the perfect fusion of these genres. Dive into the world of trucking and enjoy the best features from each category.
Realistic Extreme Truck Driver Experience Immerse yourself in a highly realistic Indian truck simulator games that delivers an authentic truck driving experience. With advanced physics and stunning graphics, you'll feel like you're behind the wheel of a real euro truck. Take control of various trucks, including cargo trucks, extreme trucks, and even the iconic garbage truck, as you navigate through challenging landscapes.
Master the Art of Truck Driving Become the ultimate truck driver simulator expert as you conquer various terrains and master the art of precision driving. From navigating tight corners in city truck simulator missions to maneuvering through challenging parking scenarios, this truck racing game will test your skills and push you to your limits.
Conquer Extreme Terrains with Extreme Trucks Are you ready for the ultimate trucking challenge? Take the wheel of powerful extreme trucks designed to conquer the toughest terrains. Experience the thrill of driving through rugged mountains, slippery roads. As an extreme truck driver, you'll need courage, skill, and determination to reach your destination.
Challenge Yourself with Trailer Driving and Truck Parking Refine your driving skills with the Trailer Driving Game and Truck Parking Game modes. Demonstrate your precision by parking your truck in challenging and tight spaces. Are you up for the challenge?
Feel the Adrenaline in Truck Races Put the pedal to the metal and participate in heart-pounding Truck Races. Truck racing game enables you to Compete against skilled opponents on thrilling racing tracks, showcasing your speed and maneuvering skills. Experience the adrenaline rush as you fight for victory and the title of the fastest truck racer.
Embark on a Global Trucking Adventure Explore various regions of the world, from the vibrant cities of the USA to the picturesque landscapes of Europe. Become a world-class truck driver and be the ultimate USA trucker.
Experience the Versatility of Cargo Trucks and Trailers As a cargo truck driver; you'll transport a variety of goods in your cargo trailer truck across vast distances. Load up your cargo truck and embark on exciting journeys to deliver items ranging from heavy construction machinery to delicate cargo.
Note : If you choose to join Ultimate Truck Simulator Game as a Vip member, you are agreeing to an auto-renewing subscription plan that will automatically be charged through your account as per your choice of plan.

bluejetty:00024537:ios.description:
Kids can’t sleep? This app is for you. 
As parents, we love those sweet bedtime moments, like reading a story, or cuddling in the rocking chair. However, when it comes to actually SLEEPING, some little ones need a little help! We get it. We’re parents too. Sound is THE solution to help create a bedroom environment fit for sleep. 
USE SOUND TO MAKE BEDTIME EASY: 
White Noise • Sleep Stories • Environmental Sounds • Lullabies • Meditations 
WHY BUDGE BEDTIME:
• Prepare them for a good night’s sleep with a custom bedtime routine
• Expertly designed audio tracks to help calm, soothe, and relax kids
• Audio-Only design keeps kids focused on sound not screens
• Exclusive lullabies, sleep stories, and meditations your kid will love
• Keep the sounds playing in the background, even while you use your other apps
SOUNDTRACKS TAILORED TO YOUR CHILDREN:
• BABIES – White Noise Sounds (Fan, Heart Beat, Washing Machine)
• TODDLERS – Lullabies, Nature Sounds, and Stories
• YOUNG CHILDREN – Stories and Mediations
DREAMY DESIGN:
• Easy to use, simple design
• AirPlay compatible to play on Bluetooth devices and speakers.
• Totally ad-free
ABOUT BUDGE
We’ve made some of your kids’ FAVORITE apps. We have spent nearly 10 years designing the BEST experiences in play. We couldn’t be more thrilled to bring joy to your family in a whole new way, by making bedtime EASY. 
Check out our newest releases for daytime fun with your little one: Barbie Dreamhouse Adventures, Thomas & Friends: Go Go Thomas, Budge World, and tons more! 
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
- This app may offer monthly or yearly subscriptions. 
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your subscription
- Users may be offered a free trial of the subscription in accordance with banners inside the app
- One free trial per Apple ID account on new subscriptions only
- If a free trial is offered, users will need to opt-in to a subscription in order to accept the trial period and will have the right to opt-out at any time during the trial period until at least 24 hrs prior to the end of the trial period. Users will be automatically charged after the trial period if they have not opted out at least 24 hrs prior to the end of the trial period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hrs before the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
- You can cancel your subscription at any time, but please note that you will not get a refund for any remaining period of a subscription
- Like all other Apple subscription apps, this app cannot use family sharing to share subscriptions across family members 
- If you have any questions or need help, please contact our Customer Support at support@budgestudios.ca
PRIVACY, SAFETY & TERMS OF USE
Budge Studios™ takes children's privacy seriously and ensures that its apps are compliant with privacy laws. This application has received the "ESRB (Entertainment Software Rating Board) Privacy Certified Kids' Privacy Seal". For more information, please visit our privacy policy at: https://budgestudios.com/en/legal/privacy-policy/, or email our Data Protection Officer at: privacy@budgestudios.ca
Downloading and/or using this app is subject to an End-User License Agreement: https://budgestudios.com/en/legal-embed/eula/
Before you download this app, please note that this app may be free to try, but some content may only be available to subscribed users.

bluejetty:00044719:ios.description:
Meet Pika, the mind-blowing AI video maker that brings your wildest dreams and weirdest ideas to life. Insert yourself into a famous painting. Kiss a troll. Put a bunny in your bathtub. Squish a skyscraper. With Pika, literally anything is possible. 
1. Pikaswaps
Put your cat in the grand canyon. Turn the Mississippi River to lava. With Pikaswaps, the options are endless. Use your photos or text prompts to replace any element in any of your video, with hyper-real results. 
2. Pikamemes
React to posts, threads, and comments with custom GIFs, generated from just a single selfie. Turn yourself into your favorite emoji, blow an air kiss, or vomit slime. Whatever your mood, we’ve got a meme. 
3. Pikadditions
Catch everyone’s attention with surprising objects, people, and fantastical elements dropped right in to your videos. Let your imagination run wild on selfies, iconic clips, POV videos, or anything you imagine, while preserving the original video and sound.
4. Pikaffects
Pikafy any of your photos with different Pikaffects like Cakeify, Melt, Explode, Squish, Levitate and more. We're always releasing new Pikaffects, and with the Pika app, you'll get first access to all of them.
5. Pikascenes 
Choose from different scenes like “Guard your castle,” “Fly in the sky,” and make them your own, swapping out characters, backgrounds, wardrobe and more with what you upload. Or, start from scratch and build your own video using just your photos and a text prompt of your creation. 
6. Image-to-Video
Turn any of your photos into a dynamic video. All you need is a photo and an idea.
7. Text-to-Video
Start with a simple text prompt. Your imagination + Pika’s magic = a whole new reality.
Why are you still reading this? Download the Pika app and start playing!

Command Epic Naval Battles:
Engage in tactical 7v7 naval battles that test your strategic skills and combat prowess. From quick skirmishes to deep strategic maneuvers, every match provides a new and exciting challenge.

Experience Diverse Challenges:

bluejetty:00031782:ios.name: Merge Hospital by Operate Now
bluejetty:00031782:ios.summary: Get E-MERGE-D in the merge story of Merge Hospital by Operate Now! In this merge and build game you play as the merge tycoon: Dr. Player. You must match and merge items and manage the medical staff of the San Mori Hospital. By completing ta
bluejetty:00031782:ios.description:
Get E-MERGE-D in the merge story of Merge Hospital by Operate Now! In this merge and build game you play as the merge tycoon: Dr. Player. You must match and merge items and manage the medical staff of the San Mori Hospital. By completing tasks you will earn money that you can use to build your hospital. Get e- merged in the merge and story of this medical drama Doctor! 
You’re the new doctor in town! You will discover the many secrets of your staff members and discover what is happening in and around the hospital. In Merge Hospital by Operate Now you will merge and build, meet and love many highly skilled surgeons, doctors and other interesting characters. You will learn more about their stories and how they got into the hospital. What are you waiting for Doctor? Merge build now!
Can you help your medical staff by merging the items? Just like in real hospitals, there is never a dull moment in Merge Hospital by Operate Now. Merge items, match them together, complete tasks and earn money to spend on new medicine and upgrading the hospital. Your medical team is depending on you, Doctor! You will not only merge and match medical items for your medical team, but they also love pies and other food and dishes. So make sure to merge and build some delicious pies to keep them happy. In this free merge game you will merge 2 items to combine them into better versions, and remember, they not only love medicine, but they also love food!
As a new chief of the outpatient department you will find yourself in the San Mori Hospital where you meet with Nurse Sandy and discover the story of how you are connected. But you will also get to meet all the other surgeons, doctors and nurses in the hospital. 
Meet your medical team: 
- Nurse Sandy Haasan: a mysterious nurse who knows a lot about you. As the Head Nurse of the department she will help you find the right merge strategy. Discover the merge story about how you are connected.
- Paramedic Gary Walker: a mechanic that became a paramedic. He knows how to merge things and especially how to tune ambulances. He is in conflict with Matt who thinks Gary stole his job after the incident that happened. They are definitely no match! 
- Doctor John Ford: a relaxed, but arrogant- yet professional doctor that will be on your side from day one. Dr. John grew up in his parents' mansion with his little sister Rosita. He fears making mistakes as past events are forever hunting him.
- Doctor Adam Fury: he may have failed as an artist, but e- merged as an highly skilled plastic surgeon. Dr. Fury merged two disciplines into one! He uses rather unorthodox procedures and only delivers masterpieces.
- Pharmacists Chris & Viktoria: get to know Chris Chow & Viktoria Vinoski and discover the events that are happening within the San Mori Hospital. Viktoria merged a new medicine, but Chris matched some evidence against her.
As Doctor merge tycoon your task is to find the right merge strategy. You’ll get to meet Dr. Pae, a highly skilled Neurosurgeon & Emilia, a bureaucratic woman protecting the hospital's reputation & George, the patient that never left.
As the new chief of the outpatient department you will: 
- MERGE and build medical items, pies and much more your medical staff needs.
- MANAGE the hospital and improve the facilities in this merging game. 
- MONITOR your medical staff and work alongside them.
- DISCOVER the merge story of a medical drama like in your favorite medical shows.
- EXPLORE the merge and story of the hospital and your medical team.
- RELAX and enjoy a casual merge build game with interesting characters, dialogues, story and well crafted animated comics. 
Love merging games? You will love Merge Hospital by Operate Now. This free merge game has 3D graphics, a compelling and interesting medical drama story and many items you can merge on the casual merge board. Merge 2 items while upgrading the hospital. 
Follow us on our socials
Facebook & Instagram: @mergehospital

apple-macos:1553636330.name: Cloud Fundamentals Cert Prep
apple-macos:1553636330.description:
The complete, ad-free companion for Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900): 101 exam-style questions covering every domain of the current exam, each with a full explanation.
WHY THIS APP
Most AZ-900 quiz apps are thin question dumps with no explanations or a domain mix that doesn't match the real exam. This one is built and weighted to Microsoft's official AZ-900 exam guide, and every question; not just the answer key; comes with a full explanation of why the right choice is right and the others are wrong.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
- 101 exam-style questions weighted to match the official AZ-900 domain breakdown
- Every question comes with a detailed explanation
- Choose 5, 10, or 15 questions per practice session
- Track your progress, streaks, and score history right on your device
- Works fully offline — study on a plane, a commute, anywhere
- No ads, no account, no sign-up
EXAM DOMAINS COVERED
- Describe Cloud Concepts (25–30%): shared responsibility model, cloud economics (CapEx vs. OpEx), high availability and scalability, IaaS/PaaS/SaaS
- Describe Azure Architecture and Services (35–40%): compute (VMs, containers, Azure Functions), networking, storage, databases, AI/ML services
- Describe Azure Management and Governance (30–35%): cost management, Azure Policy, RBAC, Azure Portal/CLI/PowerShell, monitoring tools
BUILT FOR REAL STUDYING
Every question is written as a scenario a working cloud professional would actually face, with distractor answers that test common misconceptions rather than obvious wrong picks. Explanations spell out the reasoning so you learn the concept, not just memorize a letter.
MORE THAN ONE EXAM?
This app is part of the Djamgatech PRO family. If you're studying for more than just Azure Fundamentals, Djamgatech PRO covers 53 certifications across AWS, Azure, GCP, and AI all offline, all in one app, all ad-free.
Study smarter, walk into your AZ-900 exam ready, and pass with confidence.

apple-macos:6793196260.name: OvateChat
apple-macos:6793196260.description:
OvateChat is a private messenger built on one principle: your conversations belong to you.
Every message, photo, video, voice note, file, call and story is protected with end-to-end encryption using the Signal Protocol — the cryptography trusted by security experts worldwide. Your keys never leave your phone. Not even we can read what you send.
PRIVATE BY ARCHITECTURE • End-to-end encrypted messages, media, calls, groups, channels and stories • Delivered messages are wiped from our servers — we keep no copy of your ciphertext • No ads, no trackers, no analytics, no data selling — ever • No phone number: sign up with a username and an email address • Friends by username — your address book is never uploaded
EVERYTHING YOU EXPECT • One-to-one and group chats with reactions, replies, editing and delete for everyone • Audio and video calls, one-to-one and in groups • Photos, videos, documents and large files, voice notes and location sharing • Stories for the friends you choose — 6, 12 or 24 hours, then gone • Channels: follow public channels, or open your own • Stickers, sticker packs and a sticker maker; GIFs • Disappearing messages, starred messages, message search • Read receipts and typing awareness you control • Your own name for each contact — only you see it • Several accounts on one phone; link a second device
YOUR DATA, YOUR RULES • Control who can find you and who can message you • Block, report and mute with one tap • App lock with Face ID or a PIN; screenshot notices • Encrypted backup — encrypted on your phone before it is stored • Switch an account off, or delete it any time, right from the app • Dark mode, Arabic and right-to-left support
OvateChat is built and operated by Ovate Technologies. Read our privacy policy at https://ovatechat.com/privacy — the short version: privacy isn't a setting, it's the architecture.

apple-macos:6756544631.description:
Create Custom Workout Timers with Ease
Take control of your fitness routine with a powerful workout timer designed for maximum flexibility — Mac, iPad, or iPhone (with an Apple Watch companion app). Whether you're into HIIT, circuit training, strength workouts, or any custom routine, this app adapts to your needs.
Key Features:
• Flexible Exercise Setup — Add, remove, duplicate, and rearrange exercises in any order to match your workout style
• Time or Reps — Choose whether each exercise is time-based or rep-based, with optional weight and target-rep tracking for strength work
• Saved Routines — Build a routine once, save it by name, and launch it again anytime from your routine library
• Smart Rest Periods — Set individual rest intervals after each exercise to optimize your recovery
• Apple Watch Companion — Run your entire workout from your wrist, fully synced with your iPhone in real time
• Heart Rate Zones — See live BPM, calories, and heart-rate zone on iPhone and Apple Watch during your workout
• Siri & Shortcuts — Start a saved routine hands-free with "Hey Siri" or a Home Screen shortcut
• Audio Alerts — Stay focused with sound notifications when each timer expires — no need to watch the screen
• Full Timer Control — Pause, resume, skip, or cancel your routine at any time
• Screen Wake — Keep your device's screen active throughout your workout so you never miss a beat
• Import/Export Routines — Save and share your favorite workouts, or try routines from others
• Completion Notifications — Get notified when your entire routine is finished
Perfect for home workouts, gym sessions, yoga flows, stretching routines, and more. Build your ideal workout once, then execute it perfectly every time — on whichever Apple device you have with you.
